title: Selected ventures
intro: I build things where human growth, imagination and craft meet. Some are digital homes for people and their ideas; some are worlds, scents and keepsakes you can hold; some are places to heal. This is a selection of the ventures I'm shaping now.

projects.title: YOU
projects.description: A human development and community ecosystem: personal growth, community, guided journeys, events, a marketplace and gamification.
projects.portfolioDescription: A home for growing, together. YOU brings personal development and community into one place: guided journeys to follow at your own pace, events to meet in person, a marketplace for people who help others grow, and a playful layer that notices progress and makes it feel worth celebrating.

projects.title: YOUrigin
projects.description: A personal creative operating environment for ideas, writing, lyrics, research, Projects and Works.
projects.portfolioDescription: A personal creative operating environment. YOUrigin gives ideas, writing, lyrics and research somewhere to land the moment they arrive, then helps them grow into Projects and finished Works. It is private by design, works offline, and keeps a whole creative life in one calm place.

projects.title: CommYOUnity
projects.description: A small app for the people living and working at Terra Sangha, an eight-hectare community on the land in Portugal.
projects.portfolioDescription: A shared home, in an app, for the people living and working at Terra Sangha, an eight-hectare community on the land in Portugal. CommYOUnity brings together community tasks and rotas, shared expenses, a calendar of arrivals and gatherings, a noticeboard, and GratitYOUde, a simple way to thank one another.

projects.title: Wandering
projects.description: A modern explorer's atlas for documenting adventures, planning journeys, preserving memories and discovering where friends are.
projects.portfolioDescription: A modern explorer's atlas. Wandering keeps a private map of where you've been, where you dream of going and the journeys you're planning, alongside a separate map of friends who choose to share where they are, so it's easier to meet in real life.

images.alt: The Atlas screen on a phone: a map of Portugal with two blue flags joined by a route near Coimbra, a dashed flight line heading out to sea, and an "Add a place" button.
The Plan screen: an expedition card, "Portugal by train", 1 to 14 May 2027, and two routes, "The long way to Kyoto" and "Up the coast by rail".
A route called "The long way to Kyoto": a dashed arc over a world map joining three numbered waypoints, 11,767 km by air.
The "Portugal by train" expedition: an itinerary of Lisbon (ticked), Coimbra and Porto, with Up, Down and Remove for each stop.
The Journal screen: New Moment and Check in buttons, tag chips such as #mountains and #palaces, and a Moment from Sintra on Saturday 4 April 2026.

projects.title: Atlantean Gardens
projects.description: A botanical brand and imaginative world with characters, realms, strain collections and an interactive Atlas.
projects.portfolioDescription: The idea, in development: the story of Atlantean Gardens, bringing love, creativity and joy back to the world of plant medicine, especially cannabis. A plant guide with a real folklore story woven through it, told through painted strain cards, the Atlas and its realms, and the five Keepers. The full immersive experience is being rebuilt.

images.alt: The Atlantean Gardens idea page opens over a painted map of a forested island city: the guide emblem of a meditating chimp on his cloud, the title "Atlantean Gardens", "Atlantis Rising · Myth Made Medicine", and "Bringing love, creativity and joy back to the world of plant medicine, especially cannabis."
Chapter II, "Each strain is a story. Each card is a character.", above a fan of seven painted collector cards, each a chimp character with a strain name and card number.

Chapter V, "Tended by five Keepers": painted cards for Kasper (the Spirit, wonder), Lila (the Heart, love), Coco (the Hands, stewardship), D'Nine (the Mind, creation) and Raptor (the Will, courage), each with their question, and "Only together does the Garden truly bloom."

projects.title: Sweet Vital Nectar
projects.description: A fragrance brand: personal scent and botanical roll-on perfumes.
projects.portfolioDescription: A fragrance brand about personal scent. Sweet Vital Nectar makes botanical roll-on perfumes: small, warm and close to the skin.

projects.title: Hopeium
projects.description: A human-centred wellbeing and therapy concept: a warm home for growth.
projects.portfolioDescription: A warm home for growth. Hopeium is a human-centred wellbeing and therapy concept, designed to feel welcoming from the first moment, with simplicity and kindness put ahead of clinical distance.

images.alt: Home page: the HOPEIUM name with a lighthouse for the letter I, over dusky mountains and a low sun, with a "Get support now" button.
Support page: "How would you like to reach out?", with two cream cards, "Book a session" and "Request the next available time".
Request page: "You don't need the perfect words.", above a short form asking for a name and how to be contacted.

projects.title: Empatherapy
projects.description: A therapeutic and wellbeing venture, including the Empatherapy healing fund initiative.
projects.portfolioDescription: Therapy and wellbeing grounded in empathy. Alongside its sessions, Empatherapy gives 10% of session revenue to its own Healing Fund.

projects.title: Chantilly's Tallow
projects.description: Grass-fed, organic tallow skincare, handcrafted on a farm in Gippsland.
projects.portfolioDescription: Grass-fed, organic tallow skincare, handcrafted on a farm in Gippsland with ethical, sustainable practices. A client project I assisted with.

projects.title: ReFocus Counselling
projects.description: Counselling with Julie Santall, helping people transform past pain into lasting strength.
projects.portfolioDescription: Counselling with Julie Santall, who brings more than 35 years of experience to helping people transform past pain into lasting strength and rewrite their own story. A client project I assisted with.
